input_settings.purpose: Select s0 by the five-system mean absolute HOMO ionization-energy error while p is fixed.
input_settings.selection_metric: mean absolute error of -epsilon_HOMO in eV
input_settings.selection_rule: minimum among points for which all five calculations converge

atomic_input_settings.purpose: Matched exchange-only atomic calculations and diffuse negative-energy virtual-state analysis.
atomic_input_settings.negative_virtual_definition: occupation <= occupation_threshold and orbital energy < negative_virtual_threshold_ha
atomic_input_settings.degeneracy_grouping: energy-sorted states within degeneracy_tolerance_ha of the first state in the current group

he_basis_sensitivity.generated_exponent_rule: alpha_new = alpha_most_diffuse^2 / alpha_next_diffuse for each angular momentum; contraction coefficient 1

method.p_role: fixed design choice; not fitted in this scan
method.aggregation_rule: mae_5system_eV is present only if all H, He, Li, Na, and K calculations converged; no failed system is excluded
method.homo_definition: maximum eigenvalue among orbitals with mo_occ > 0, preserving the occupation mask rather than flatten-and-index counting
method.one_electron_protocol: H, Li/CRENBL, Na/SBKJC, and K/SBKJC use the same s-symmetric direct occupied-orbital minimization after the zero-level-shift stage
